title: Forward composition policy into direct ModuleRuntime calls
goal: Ensure policies injected into M6 and M7 composition roots also guard direct calls to their exposed ModuleRuntime.
context: M6CompositionRoot and M7CompositionRoot accept PolicyEvaluating for orchestration but omit it when constructing ModuleRuntime. This means direct module calls can bypass the supplied policy. M8 already passes its resolved policy.
forbidden_changes: Do not change policy semantics or introduce default permissions.
Do not alter UI, provider, storage, or Xcode project files.
Do not claim fail-closed behavior when no policy is supplied.
acceptance_criteria: M6 ModuleRuntime receives the policy passed to M6CompositionRoot.
M7 ModuleRuntime receives the policy passed to M7CompositionRoot.
Regression tests prove a supplied denying policy rejects direct module execution through both roots.
Existing M6 and M7 behavior remains covered by their test suites.
verification: Validate this task contract with Scripts/agent_task_guard.py.
Check M3 and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA CI separately; physical-device verification remains separate.
recovery: Revert the single task commit if regression tests or required CI fail; keep the policy-bypass finding open until verified.
